How does the DAS track the 15-working-day deadline for the electricity-aid inquiry? Is there a register or system alert?

Who in the town hall puts the borderou data into the PIEE, and is this done at all?

Which databases does the DAS check for income and assets (ANAF, pension house, local tax, ANPIS SAFIR?), who runs the check, and is it automatic?

Does the applicant fetch the town-hall asset certificate (tax/agricultural register) or does the DAS obtain it internally from the other department?
